title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・暗雲、じゃない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky finishes the spring Tenno Sho and confirms that Special Week has improved even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: How is she supposed to continue competing when her talented opponents just keep getting better and better?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells me there's something she wants to find out…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, she decides to race in the Takarazuka Kinen against Special Week and Grass Wonder.
